changelog: The legacy settings screen search-history switch now controls the flag the runtime honours instead of a superseded key.
Removed the notification-sound picker: CSM posts through low-importance channels, so Android decides the sound.
Pinned the shipped variant policy: broken, hidden and stub features stay invisible and dev mode cannot be unlocked.
Added contract tests for the legacy settings surface and the variant gating.
message: Legacy settings truth and shipped variant policy tests
